headline: Affordable Housing Trust Fund amendment, janitorial emergency funds, and Saco general assistance agreement up for approval; parking garage fees presented.
summary: A citizen appointment to a committee and the November 3, 2026 election results are up for approval. Presentations cover parking garage fees, the finance audit, and the Opportunity Zone designation.
items: Mayoral appointment of a citizen to a committee
General assistance coverage for Saco, memorandum of understanding
Amendment to Affordable Housing Trust Fund agreement with Biddeford Housing Authority
Bureau of Highway Safety grant acceptance
Use of contingency funds for janitorial services, emergency procurement
FY28 budget process for municipal and social services application and funding
